title: Documentation: simplify protocol tree function documentation intro
description:
The protocol tree function list is becoming massive, therefore not useful.
Limiting the intro to some essential examples and referring to epan/proto.h
for the full set solves this.

notes.body:
Would it possibly make sense to move this part of the README into Doxygen comments for [proto.h](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsar_html/proto_8h.html) or the like and then just reference that?

FWIW, I'm in favor of trying to migrate all of the README's to either the WSUG, WSDG, or Doxygen.
